name: Hotel Seppl
beschreibung: Hotel Seppl is situated in the scenic village of Mutters on a sunny plateau just south of Innsbruck. Built in authentic Tyrolean style with local timber and stone, it offers a warm and tranquil environment. Guests enjoy close proximity to the family-friendly Muttereralm ski and recreation area and panoramic summer trails. Facilities include a restorative wellness area with sauna, steam bath, and relaxation lounge, alongside an acclaimed regional restaurant.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Seppl in Mutters near Innsbruck provides peaceful alpine lodging, a sauna and steam wellness area, regional dining, and easy access to the Muttereralm ski and hiking area.
